title: Pricing AI work
scope: Public US-dollar offer observations. Features and prices can change. The separate euro scenario is illustrative.

offers.name: Intercom Fin
offers.unit: One billable outcome per Intercom chat or email conversation
offers.observation: These rates apply to Fin in Intercom chat and email. Voice has separate pricing. A resolution and a qualified prospect carry different prices. A failed procedure earns no outcome fee. Multiple steps still count as at most one billable outcome per conversation.

sources.title: Fin outcome definitions and billing rules

offers.name: Section Coach
offers.observation: Section’s November 2026 individual membership guide gives Basic members five saved use cases. Premium adds unlimited cases, live workshops and monthly office hours.

offers.name: Reforge
offers.unit: One seat or an annual team membership
offers.observation: Individual access includes live courses and a library of working documents. The ten-seat Starter plan adds administration and engagement reporting for the team buyer.

offers.name: The Information Pro
offers.observation: Pro readers can interrogate newsroom databases. Its generative AI research draws on company financing and investor information alongside the publication’s reporting.
offers.priceNote: The comparison concerns data access. Promotional subscription prices are omitted.

scenario.evidence: Illustrative assumptions, excluding tax. Capacity has value only when the buyer can redeploy it.
